purpose: Detect evidence that would have materially improved a current analysis if it had been tracked historically, then close the evidence gap safely without changing market semantics.
trigger_question: Would this analysis be materially stronger now if a specific observable metric had already been tracked over prior days or weeks?
rules: Never infer or fabricate historical values.
Backfill is permitted only from an allowlisted capability whose contract explicitly supports historical retrieval.
Perishable point-in-time evidence that cannot be reconstructed must start prospective capture and preserve the historical hole as UNKNOWN.
A newly useful metric is evidence only. It cannot become a sensor, rule, threshold, weight, BUY condition, EXIT condition or canonical state transition without the existing governance path.
Existing retained GitHub evidence must be checked before any new collector or paid research call is proposed.
Repeated semantically equivalent gaps must deduplicate into one registry item with incremented observation_count and updated last_seen_utc.
Source discovery may recommend an implementation path but cannot invent source authority or silently promote a source to canonical ownership.
Automatic code self-merge is forbidden. New collector code must pass normal branch, PR and CI gates before merge.
